title: Scientific Normalization & Acceptance Semantics for the Bounded Richards Temporal Indicator

candidate.H_budget_requirement: explicit finite positive head-domain numerical/application accuracy budget in cm with independent provenance

what_is_qualified: Scientific and dimensional coherence of the non-empirical normalization C_h=B_inf/H_budget.
Separation of estimator, normalization, application/numerical accuracy budget, transaction policy, hard mass gate and coupling residual tolerances.
Compatibility with F-KT09's generic dimensionless finite nonnegative <=1 model-owned certificate interface without changing F-KT09 semantics.
Exact-linear implication only in the previously qualified exact-linear theorem scope.
Fail-closed/unavailable semantics for invalid budget, invalid/unavailable indicator, unsupported operator envelope and unqualified continuation provenance.
Preservation of F-VQ28 and F-VQ29 negative evidence and F-VQ30 nonlinear finite-comparator qualification boundaries.
what_is_not_qualified: A universal or application-independent temporal head tolerance.
B_inf or C_h as a general nonlinear true-error upper bound/certificate.
Monotone improvement of C_h under shorter retry dt.
Production initial bootstrap, arbitrary restart-history reconstruction or forcing/event/topology-discontinuity continuation.
Groundwater coupling, F-GC02 or F-PE release.
next_required_work: Open or resume an independent F-VQ workunit to qualify the fixed normalization semantics without selecting a default H_budget and without converting nonlinear transfer evidence into a true-error claim.

Independent qualification should include source-lock reproduction, exact-linear ratio semantics, invalid/unavailable fail-closed behavior, nonlinear composition/noninterference, budget scaling invariance and preservation of negative retry evidence.
Only after independent normalization qualification may a separate F-KT policy workunit bind an explicitly supplied H_budget/C_h certificate to bounded production acceptance and retry semantics.

A separate continuation-provenance/bootstrap qualification remains required before model-owned certificate mode can be relied on from initial no-history, arbitrary restart or discontinuity boundaries.
Resume existing F-GC02 only after scientific normalization, production F-KT binding and required continuity provenance are independently qualified.
